description: Red bort 90, raised in 1982 as a monument to the labour record of the Irkutsk aviation plant.
Full-scale mock-up of the ANT-31 (I-14) fighter, the first type built at the Irkutsk plant. Not an original airframe.
Light four-seater built at Irkutsk. Construction number recorded only tentatively by russianplanes and therefore omitted from aliases.
A-002 autogyro developed and built at the Irkutsk plant.
Blue bort 45. c/n 9970204. Wears bort number 45; recorded without a tail number because another airframe of this type in the database already carries it.
Irkutsk-built Su-30, blue bort 07; russianplanes designates it Su-30 I-7. c/n 96310102001.
MiG-27K built at Irkutsk. No bort number recorded; construction number not established.
